description:
Replace exact text: old_text to new_text, or edits[] for several replacements in one file (edits[] wins).
Use when: you make a targeted change. old_text must match exactly once; replace_all=1 replaces every match. pass expected_sha256 to refuse stale content and get a verified re-read.
Avoid when: you rewrite the whole file (project_write_file) or change several files at once (project_edit_batch).
Output: replacements, sha256_before, sha256_after, verified (when expected_sha256 is given). Failures: old_text_not_found, old_text_ambiguous (returns each match with line context).

edits.description: Multiple section replacements in this file; takes precedence over old_text/new_text. Create a scoped project_snapshot first when applying 2+ edits or when the change is hard to recreate.

replace_all.description: 1 replaces every match; 0 (default) requires exactly one match.

expected_sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file's current full content. The edit is refused if the file on disk differs. Use sha256_after from your last write/edit of this file; read_file's sha256 only matches when the whole file was returned. When given, the result is re-read after the write and reports verified.

new_text.description: Replacement text (paired with old_text; ignored when edits[] is given).

old_text.description: Exact text to replace. Must match exactly once unless replace_all=1. Ignored when edits[] is given.

reason.description: Optional why (max 400 chars), audit-logged. Required only on project_ci_control.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative ('.' = root); absolute/.. outside it rejected.
